comparison: Use an integer-indexed family of measurable real random variables with finite second moments, constant finite mean and centered covariance depending only on the lag. ProbabilityTheory.covariance is centered, and MemLp at exponent two supplies the integrability domain that its total real-integral definition otherwise does not enforce. Absolute summability of the lag covariance sequence is l1 membership, not summability without absolute values or a finite list of lags. The corresponding nonnegative spectral density on [-pi,pi] requires its Fourier-series relationship to that sequence and the paper's normalization convention; mere nonnegativity of an arbitrary function is insufficient. Theta is a finite-dimensional spectral parameter in a subset of R^p, not necessarily a complete parametric specification of the process law. Do not add zero mean, Gaussianity, linearity, strict stationarity, mixing or fourth-order stationarity from later stronger assumptions.
